title: Resident electricity consumption prediction method based on deep learning and federal learning

pse.problem: Existing residential electricity consumption prediction methods struggle with varying resident habits, privacy concerns, and poor convergence speed, leading to decreased accuracy.
pse.solution_function: The method proposes a residential electricity consumption prediction model based on deep learning and federated learning. The model uses cloud-edge collaboration for training on edge devices while maintaining user data privacy. Federated learning personalizes the prediction, reducing errors.
pse.solution_structure: A cloud-edge collaborative architecture is established to combine edge computing with cloud computing. A federated learning edge model based on EMD-LSTM (Empirical Mode Decomposition Long Short-Term Memory) is constructed for residential electricity consumption prediction.
pse.solution_implementation: The model collects data from edge devices, trains the model using federated learning, and personalizes the predictions. The cloud server aggregates models from multiple users to improve accuracy.
pse.effect: The method improves prediction accuracy while protecting user privacy by addressing resident-specific electricity consumption patterns.
